neighbours.label: the financial institution to contact, after 'your' (your bank, your credit card company, your card issuer, your financial institution)
fire: Should you notice a payment you did not make, ring your bank straight away.
If the cash machine keeps your card, tell your bank as soon as you can.
Dispute the charge with your credit card company within sixty days.
Before travelling abroad, let your card issuer know your dates.
When a cheque bounces, speak to your financial institution about the fees.
Never share your PIN, and alert your bank if someone asks for it.
If the transfer has not arrived by Friday, check with your credit union.
To raise your spending limit, write to your card company and enclose a payslip.
quiet: If water starts dripping under the sink, ring your plumber straight away.
The central bank kept interest rates unchanged in June.
While you are away on holiday, ask your neighbour to water the plants.
When the fever lasts more than three days, speak to your doctor about tests.
Never leave your umbrella on the train, and label your suitcase clearly.
They had a picnic on the grassy bank beside the canal.
To renew your passport, write to the embassy and enclose two photos.
The credit card was invented in the middle of the last century.

notes: Card: 'contact your bank', 'notify your bank', 'credit card company', 'your financial institution', but also clients / citizens / 'Your Child'. Probing: your bank 0.57-0.89, card company 0.76, financial institution 0.61, card issuer 0.44; your doctor / landlord / teacher / lender below 0.04, river bank 0.02, 'The bank raised' 0.05, your child 0.16. The label covers the money cases only.
